MERCHANT OF RECORD FEE CALCULATOR · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER

Stripe or a merchant of record: what do you actually keep?

Enter your monthly revenue, average sale price and international share. Get Stripe, Stripe Tax, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy and Polar priced side by side, with the cost of filing sales tax and VAT yourself counted where the platform is not the seller, plus the monthly revenue where the cheapest option changes.

Nothing is uploaded. Calculated in this browser from numbers you enter and approximate list prices you can edit. It cannot see your account and is not tax advice.

Where the lowest-cost option changes

Revenue per month (USD)Lowest total cost

At small revenue the fixed monthly cost of registering and filing yourself dominates, which favours a merchant of record. As revenue grows the platform's higher percentage costs more than a filing service, which favours Stripe. Fixed per-sale fees also hit small tickets hardest. Set the filing cost to what a bookkeeper or tax service would really charge you.

Rate cards (editable)

Merchant-of-record options (Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar) are treated as the seller, so no filing cost is added. Press Compare after changing a value.

Prefer a CLI, or want a fee ceiling in CI?

node cli.mjs compare --revenue 5000 --price 29 --intl 60 --growth 5
node cli.mjs compare --revenue 5000 --provider paddle --max-fee-pct 6   # exit 1 over ceiling
node cli.mjs crossover --price 29 --tax 150
node cli.mjs compare --revenue 5000 --prices prices.json --json

Get cli.mjs and engine.mjs — Node 18+, nothing to install, no network call. More: Stripe vs a merchant of record for indie SaaS.

Common questions

Does this read my payment account?

No. It uses only the monthly revenue, average sale price and percentages you type, and rate cards you can edit. It cannot see your processor, country, payout settings or statements. Treat every figure as a way to compare options, never as what you will be charged.

Where do the fee rates come from?

They are approximate public list prices as best known in 2025, shown with an as-of line, and every number is editable. Providers add payout, currency-conversion, dispute and subscription charges and change packaging often, so check each pricing page before deciding.

What does merchant of record change?

A merchant of record is the legal seller to your customer, so it calculates, collects and files sales tax and VAT itself. With Stripe you stay the seller and either file yourself or pay a service to; the calculator models that as a monthly filing cost you enter. Whether a platform removes a specific obligation for your business is a question for your accountant, not this tool.

Is my data uploaded anywhere?

No. The page calculates in your browser and sends nothing. The CLI reads local files and makes no network call.

It applies list prices that may be out of date and ignores payout, currency-conversion, dispute and subscription charges, negotiated rates and your own tax position; it is not a quote and not a guarantee of what any provider will charge. Product names belong to their owners; this project is not affiliated with any of them.

Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record. If a tool needs to survive, get cli.mjs and run it yourself.

Everything runs in your browser. What you enter is never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (compare_run, example_loaded) are counted only in local storage and can be deleted with the button below. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured.

Stripe vs a merchant of record for indie SaaS

Put your monthly revenue, average sale and international share into the calculator to price Stripe, Stripe Tax, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy and Polar side by side. These are the questions to settle before you trust the answer.

When does a merchant of record beat Stripe?

When you are small and sell across borders. Registering and filing sales tax and VAT in the places your customers live has a fixed monthly cost, whether you do it yourself or pay a service, and a merchant of record folds that into a higher percentage. At the default inputs the calculator puts the crossover near seven thousand dollars a month; enter your own average sale and international share to find yours.

What do the fixed per-sale fees do to small prices?

Thirty to fifty cents a sale is a rounding error on a $200 licence and a large share of a $5 one. If your average sale is under about ten dollars, compare the fixed fee before the percentage.

What does a merchant of record not solve?

Chargebacks, refunds policy, payout and currency-conversion fees, and income tax on what you keep stay yours or vary by platform. Whether a platform removes a given registration for your business is a question for your accountant.

No warranty. This page is provided free and as-is, without warranty of any kind. It is not financial, legal or tax advice; verify prices at each provider. Best-effort hosting, no SLA.
